name: shva
description: Personal command and skill pack for Shiva. v0.9.0 adds /shva:meditate, a three-mode reflection and judgment ritual for artifacts, sessions, and taste. It combines the five R's with the five-question Aliveness Review, counterexample testing, explicit record authorization, and strict private-material boundaries. Existing skills cover vocabulary briefing, LinkedIn and Medium authoring, teaching artifacts, GenAI use-case analysis, MDP source finding, persona reflection, and academic paper review.
